$comment: The analysis contract, v1. Kept identically in slskd (docs/player-analysis-provider.schema.json) and media-bridge (contracts/analysis-v1.schema.json); each repo's tests hold its side to its copy. Change both, and bump `contract` only for a change a caller cannot ignore. Unknown fields are allowed everywhere so a provider can add more without coordinating.
title: Analysis provider response

verdict.description: The row badge and the bar's sub-line.

summary.description: The findings panel's top line, free text, e.g. "AIFF · 16-bit · 44.1 kHz · stereo · 1411 kbps · 4:55".

lanes.description: Where a finding sits in the track: weights 0..100 in equal buckets across the decoded length. Never sent empty. Label and level come from the finding it names.

text.description: Text as runs. A run with `seek` is a point in the track, in seconds, that a client may make clickable.
